messages.subject: Project Lyra — export control wording (clause 10)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

On clause 10 — Marrick will run its own export-control assessment for the integrated products, but we want the drafting to make clear each party is responsible for its own licences and authorisations, not the other's. Can we confirm the current wording does that?

Fiona Deverell | General Counsel, Marrick Defence Systems plc

messages.subject: RE: Project Lyra — export control wording (clause 10)
messages.plaintextBody:
Fiona,

Yes — clause 10.1 puts the obligation to obtain and maintain licences and authorisations on each party for its own activities, and 10.2 has Marrick indemnifying Veridian for any breach by Marrick of the export-control provisions. That reflects exactly the split you describe. No change needed.

James Osei
Senior Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
